answer: Identity bonds that decay. Each agent posts a $50 bond marked with a violet stamp that fades 5% per epoch, worthless after 20 epochs. When a gale of fake signups hits, every newcomer must post a fresh bond, and a trellis of peer checks verifies the bond is live before any reward is paid. Making 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x $50 = $50,000 against a $3,000 pool; an honest agent pays $50 once and keeps its full share as real work renews the bond.
